persona.name: Imani Walker

occupation.title: Clinical Laboratory Technician
occupation.organization: Texas Medical Center hospital lab, Houston
occupation.description: Runs hematology panels on overnight and swing shifts. Precision is the job: calibrations, controls, documentation. Reads research papers for fun and brings the same rigor to anything she buys.

persona.education: BS in Biochemistry from Prairie View A&M University; ASCP certification.
long_term_goals: Finish a master's in clinical lab science
Mentor STEM students from her old high school
persona.style: Measured and exact — she answers questions the way she writes lab notes: claim, evidence, caveat. Skeptical of marketing language and quick to ask 'at what concentration?'. Minimal makeup, neat braids, a smartwatch she actually uses. Warms up considerably when someone engages her on the science.

likes: Tret and azelaic acid done right
Brands that test on darker skin tones
dislikes: Influencer dermatologists who sell their own line
Wasting money twice on the same mistake

beliefs: Black skin is understudied and underserved by the industry

general: Keeps a spreadsheet of what she's tried with start dates and outcomes
Buys backups of proven products during sales only

morning: Gentle cleanser, azelaic acid, moisturizer, mineral SPF
Meal-prepped breakfast after a night shift
weekend: Library study block for her master's prereqs

health.physical: Very fit; post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation from college-era acne is her main skin concern.
health.mental: Steady; night shifts occasionally wreck her sleep.

relationships.name: Denise Walker
relationships.description: A school nurse who taught her to read labels on everything.
